summary: Ledger updates by the main session after applying corrections.

ledger.contains: Thailand Privilege Card Co. member profile at 30 Sep 2025 (6 image pages, 115-125 ppi): pp. 1-3 members by nationality (146 nationalities in the header, 137 rows printed, 39,538 members) and package; p. 4 by package and sex with a summary box; p. 5 by package and age band with each cell's share; p. 6 by package and occupation with shares and summary boxes. Earlier passes recorded the nationality x package cells and totals (re-read by eye), and all counts on pp. 4-6. This pass re-checked pp. 4-6 against a fresh OCR of the embedded images (all stored counts confirmed) and added the printed percentages: p. 5 cell shares (many do not equal count/39,538, e.g. Old Package Total 33,900 = 87.0%, so the source seems to use another base; the new-package 40-49 cell reads 5.5% where 3.5% would fit), p. 6 cell shares (mostly about a tenth of count/39,538; meaning unclear; package totals marked item=occupation_table because they differ from p. 5), the sex summary (70.6% / 29.4%) and occupation summary boxes (19.2%, 12.3%, 21.0%, 14.3%, 4.2%, 0.3%), all as printed with the inconsistencies in notes.
